title: System
description: A set of services, APIs and resources that together deliver one or more products or a shared capability — the unit whose criticality and support mode are agreed with the business. Backstage kind: System (domain → spec.domain, the team field → spec.owner; criticality/support_mode/exposure/hosting_model → the labels of the same name).

description.title: Description
description.description: What it is, in a sentence or two - Backstage metadata.description.

type.title: Type
type.description: The System type dictionary: value-creation = a system that on its own realises a customer-facing offering listed under Products; shared-service = a building block shared by several products; integration = communication & real-time information exchange; data-and-reporting = analytical & mgmt systems; infrastructure-and-platform = underlying, lower-level basic & universal services; external = provided by 3rd party.

support_mode.title: Support mode
support_mode.description: Label support-mode: when someone answers when it breaks.

exposure.title: Exposure
exposure.description: Label exposure: who can reach it.

kubernetes_id.title: Kubernetes id
kubernetes_id.description: The value of the backstage.io/kubernetes-id label the system's workloads carry.

products.title: Delivered as part of
products.description: The products this system delivers or is shared by — a platform system lists several. Port-only (dropped on Backstage export).
